senses.gloss: भेद- + बुद्धि भेद- + बुद्धि, f. distinction, [] Bhāg. P. 3, 16, 10.

भेद भेद, i. e. भिद् + अ, m.
 1. Breaking, Vikr. d. 26.
 2. Dividing, division, Pañc. 248, 19.
 3. Separating, Pañc. 156, 19; separation, Hit. pr. 9, M.M.
 4. A chasm, a fissure, a cleft, Vikr. 69, 8; a wound, Hit. ii. d. 1. (and betrayal).
 5. Creating divisions [] Man. 7, 198.
 6. Disunion; Pañc. iv. d. 74.
 7. Betrayal, Pañc. 65, 19.
 8. Difference, Pañc. 199, 20.
 9. Kind, Hit. iv. d. 124.
 --Comp.

भेदक भेदक, i. e. भिद् + अक, m.
 1. One who breaks, Man. 8, 284 (अस्थि-).
 2. One who breaks open, 9, 280.
 3. One who scratches, 8, 284 (त्वच्-).
 4. One who diverts (watercourses), Man. 3, 163.
 5. A mischief-maker.
 --Comp.
भेदतस् भेद + तस्, adv. According to the difference, Bhag. 18, 19.

भेदन भेदन, i. e. भिद् + अन, n.
 1. Dividing.
 2. Piercing, Man. 9, 286.
 --Comp.

भेदिन् भेदिन्, i. e. भिद् + इन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Dividing, breaking, Man. 8, 218.
 2. Wounding, Hit. iv. d. 82.
 --Comp.
भेद- + विधि भेद- + विधि, m. separation, Bhartṛ. 2, 15.
